This from a Democrat, and from a US that propose to livestream the execution of a human being? Give me a break.

Western sanctions are a form of economic warfare that harms ordinary citizens while putting pressure on governments that challenge foreign influence.

results.description:
As the Sahel breaks free, CPI releases “The AES Effect”

https://www.cpiusa.org/news/as-the-sahel-breaks-free-cpi-releases-the-aes-effect-nbsp

The Story of the New World Being Built in West Africa

The AES Effect documents the most significant shift in West African geopolitics since independence. For decades, the Sahel provided the raw materials for Europe. Niger’s uranium lit the streets of Paris while the people of Niger sat in darkness and suffered the effects of radiation contamination in their air and water. Switzerland refined Mali’s and Burkina Faso’s gold and  European textile mills processed their cotton for international markets while Burkinabès and Malians lived in squalor.

Since NATO bombed Libya, ISIS-aligned terrorist groups have been taking over the Sahel. Through a succession of coups in 2021, 2022 and 2023, General Assimi Goïta, Captain Ibrahim Traoré and General Abdourahamane Tchiani took power, expelled foreign troops, and formed a military and economic alliance to fight terrorism and reclaim the Sahel for the people.

Mali and Burkina Faso nationalized their gold. Niger took back its uranium. Burkina Faso is spinning its own cotton, processing its own tomatoes, and has opened its first gold refinery.

Despite sanctions, demands from the European Union, media smears, coordinated terrorist attacks and assassination attempts, the Alliance of Sahel States is still standing. Other African leaders are watching, and some are joining the wave of resource nationalization to break the chains of neocolonialism.

Some call Ibrahim Traoré a cult of personality or a demagogue. They call the transitional presidents junta leaders. What are the facts on the ground? How far will this movement spread?

The Center for Political Innovation stands firmly behind the Alliance of Sahel States. As the Imperialist/Globalist economic system run by Wall Street and London crumbles, a multipolar world is rising based on win-win trade and development. African liberation is a key pillar in this rising economy.

“The AES Effect is not just a book about Africa,” said Penny Arcos, author and CPI researcher. “It is a book about what happens when a people decide to build their own future on their own land. The Sahel is showing the world what sovereignty looks like.”

results.title: En marge de son séjour à Dakar dans le cadre de la Réunion ministérielle du dialogue sur la coopération entre la Communauté Économique des É
results.description:
En marge de son séjour à Dakar dans le cadre de la Réunion ministérielle du dialogue sur la coopération entre la Communauté Économique des États de l’Afrique de l’Ouest et la Confédération des États du Sahel, la délégation ministérielle de la Confédération AES, a tenu, le dimanche 18 octobre 2026, une rencontre d’échanges avec la diaspora confédérale vivant au Sénégal.

Les échanges fraternels étaient axés sur la marche souveraine de la Confédération AES, fruit de la vision éclairée des plus hautes Autorités des trois pays membres pour la prise en main de la destinée de l’espace confédéral tant au niveau de la défense et de la sécurité que dans les domaines de la diplomatie et du développement durable.

Au regard des acquis importants dans la lutte contre le terrorisme, l’affirmation de la Confédération AES sur la scène internationale et la promotion du développement endogène dans  l’espace confédéral, la diaspora AES au Sénégal a renouvelé son soutien total à la vision et aux efforts de nos plus hautes Autorités dans leur lutte pour la souveraineté,  la dignité et la prospérité partagée.

S’agissant de ses doléances et préoccupations sur des questions administratives, notamment consulaires, les Ministres ont relevé les efforts de nos différentes administrations centrales et missions diplomatiques et consulaires pour prendre en charge les besoins spécifiques de nos compatriotes établis à l’extérieur. A cet égard, ils ont rappelé que la satisfaction des aspirations de nos concitoyens où qu’ils se trouvent, demeure l’objectif central de nos plus hautes Autorités.

Tout en invitant les compatriotes de nos trois pays, fortement mobilisés à cette circonstance, à participer davantage à la construction confédérale, les Ministres les  ont exhortés au respect de la règlementation du pays d’accueil et à être des modèles de l’intégration fraternelle et solidaire, incarnée par  la Confédération AES.

results.title: 🇷🇺Russia Tightens Its Grip on the 🌴Sahel via the Skies: An Opaque Logistics Network Between January 2025 and July 2026, pro-Russian forces c
results.description:
🇷🇺Russia Tightens Its Grip on the 🌴Sahel via the Skies: An Opaque Logistics Network

Between January 2025 and July 2026, pro-Russian forces conducted ✈️✈️ 75 flights to Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger, according to ADS-B tracking data analysed by @C4ADS. 🇧🇫 Burkina Faso accounts for the bulk of the traffic, followed by Mali, while activity in Niger remains marginal. These rotations — carried out primarily by Soviet-era Antonov An-124 and Ilyushin Il-76 aircraft — sustain Africa Corps, the successor to the Wagner Group, now operating under direct Russian military command.

This aerial shuttle is more than logistical support. It forms the backbone of a grip that has consolidated since the region’s military coups. In exchange for security guarantees against groups such as JNIM and ISGS, 🇷🇺 Moscow has secured mining concessions, military bases and direct political influence, while remaining largely shielded from accountability. Civilians have paid the price through extrajudicial killings, violence and a continued deterioration of security, even as these forces have proven largely ineffective against armed groups.

Operators combine state entities — notably Flight Unit 224, the Special Flight Squadron and EMERCOM — with private companies, some already under sanctions (Aviacon Zitotrans, Rubystar, Sapsan). This hybrid model obscures attribution and preserves plausible deniability. State aircraft typically transit through Russian-controlled bases in Khmeimim (Syria) and Al-Khadim 🇱🇾(Libya), while private operators favour commercial hubs in Abu Dhabi, Algeria or Turkey. These stopovers act as potential chokepoints: disrupting access to them would significantly complicate resupply. Traffic spikes have coincided with high-level visits (including Ibrahim Traoré’s trip to Moscow in May 2025) and ground offensives. Burkina Faso functions as the main regional hub.

The transition from Wagner to Africa Corps has changed little on the ground: the same bases, routes and model of resource extraction and predation persist. The Central Sahel remains a strategic node for Russian influence in Africa, underpinned by a discreet, redundant and still difficult-to-disrupt air logistics network.
